items.passageEn: Last weekend, our class visited a farm in the mountains. In the morning, there was a lot of fog, but by noon we could see the beautiful scenery. It was windy on the hill, and a ray of sunlight came through the clouds. The farmer said the air is clean here because there are no factories to pollute it.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我們班去參觀山上的一座農場。早上起了大霧，但到了中午，我們就看得到美麗的風景。山丘上風很大，一道陽光從雲層間照了下來。農夫說，這裡的空氣很乾淨，因為沒有工廠來汙染它。

questions.questionZh: 早上山上的天氣怎麼樣？
農夫說這裡的空氣為什麼很乾淨？
options: 那裡一年到頭常常下雨

referenceEn: We should recycle our old newspapers.

items.instructionZh: 用 elephant 造一個句子，描述大象，或說說你看過大象的經驗。
referenceEn: I saw an elephant at the zoo last year.
Elephants have big ears and long noses.
rubricZh: elephant 是可數名詞（例如 an elephant、elephants）
用不定冠詞時要用 an（例如 an elephant）
